message.content: {"basis":"The dashboard legend is a vertical scale with pale yellow at the top labeled “100 Low” and dark burgundy at the bottom labeled “0 High,” so darker burgundy encodes higher prevalence. Among the three available option states, NY is filled dark burgundy (High end), while NC is pale yellow (Low end) and DE is light orange/yellow (Low end). Therefore NY has the highest encoded prevalence among the options and matches the routing criterion for the highest-prevalence state.", "option_label":"Open New York (NY) prevalence detail for priority follow-up"}
